name: Giantworks: the Independents' Great Work
description: Early in the game, independent worlds in three far-apart regions quietly band together as the Founders' Compact. Years later their freighters begin to fly toward a point between them and a gigantic scaffold rises there in five stages. Nobody knows what it will be: a resort, a supercomputer, an aquarium of void whales, or the beacon that calls an extinction fleet from dark space. Convoy cargoes and spies give hints, never proof. Protect it, sabotage it or destroy it before it is finished: destroying it early is a war crime unless the Diet authorises demolition, and it may have saved the galaxy or doomed a wonder. The number of Great Works is set below (automatic: one, or two in galaxies of more than 1400 stars).

flags.description: May be the Great Work: a planet-sized supercomputer that can decide it is being abused.

flags.name: gwSanctuary
flags.label: The Leviathan Sanctuary (void aquarium)
flags.description: May be the Great Work: a glass sphere of live void whales, with a small chance of a breach.

flags.name: gwBeacon
flags.label: The Beacon
flags.description: May be the Great Work: a relay that calls the Reclaimers. Only rolled in galaxies of six or more empires.
